There is no darkness thick enough to obscure its aim. |jpname=ムルシエラゴ |jpougi_name=ソニコ・ディスパラル |jpougi=風属性ダメージ(極大)/風属性キャラに吸収効果 |jpougi_4s=風属性ダメージ(極大)/風属性キャラに吸収効果/敵のCTを1つ吸収して自分の奥義ゲージに変換 |jpflavor=特殊な加工により、弦を弾くことで超音波を発生させ目標を捕捉する。放たれた一射は暗所においても闇をかいくぐり、寸分の狂いなく急所を打ち抜く。 }} == Gameplay Notes == * This weapon is 3{{star}} uncapped when obtained. * {{UpdateHistory|kind=weapon|2025-01-17|2026-06-15}} ===Robar Tiempo=== * MC gains {{Status|Absorcion}} when a Wind ally drains a foe's HP. It counts how many times a foe's HP was drained before {{WeaponSkill|page={{PAGENAME}}|no=2}} activates. == Trivia == === Etymology === * "Murciélago" means "bat" in Spanish. * "Disparo sónico" means "sonic shot" in Spanish, whilst "disparo hipersónico" means "hypersonic shot". * "Robar tiempo" means "steal time" in Spanish. * "Sangre caliente" means "warm blood" in Spanish. * "Lluvia de Saetas" means "rain of arrows" in Spanish. * "Dos colmillos" means "two fangs" in Spanish. * The overarching theme of bats and draining refers to [[wikipedia:Vampire_bat|vampire bats]], which are known for sucking blood of other animals for sustenance. == Resources == {{RedditArchive|[https://www.reddit.com/r/Granblue_en/comments/1jf44lq/weapon_discussion_murcielago_postjan_rebal/ Reddit Weapon Discussion (2025-03-19)] (Post-January 2025 Rebalance)}} ==References==
